invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieData instance produced via HoodieListData.eager, which is never null.
The method is not shown to handle a null records input; null records would cause NullPointerException.
The method maps each input record to a single element in the result, so the record count is preserved.
The result is constructed by HoodieListData.eager.
The method assumes non-null context and hoodieTable, as they are dereferenced in calls.
